notes.note: Correction to the #3897 note on this record: ExistingSetupImportStepper's output is not byte-identical. It now uses the shared formatBytes in src-ui/src/utils/formatBytes.ts, which adds a TB step, so 1099511627776 bytes renders as "1.0 TB" where it used to render "1024.0 GB". Values below 1 TiB are unchanged. This change is intentional. Checked against both formatBytes implementations.
